title: Membership Subscription Plan Change State Machine

x-luckread.payment-gate: The target plan is applied only after a verified successful Hyperswitch renewal payment advances the paid period.

x-transitions.guard: A signed successful Hyperswitch renewal outcome advances the Subscription to the target immutable plan version and a new period at or after effective_at in the same D1-01 transaction.
The Subscription is paused, canceled, or expired, or its cancel_at becomes non-null before the scheduled plan is applied.

reconciliation.renewalOfferSnapshot: D1-04 is a durable snapshot of the target offer for one exact renewal cycle, not the schedule authority.
reconciliation.failedPayment: The Subscription remains on the source plan and transitions ACTIVE to PAST_DUE; the scheduled change remains SCHEDULED for an idempotent retry of the exact cycle.
reconciliation.pauseOrCancel: A D1-01 trigger cancels a pending schedule when Subscription lifecycle state makes the next paid period ineligible.
reconciliation.noEarlyEntitlement: Scheduling does not mutate the Subscription plan or current entitlement; the paid outcome sync is the only plan-application path.
